notes: The export ran with maskSensitive=true, and the only true secret in the estate (Key Vault secret 'demo-secret') was NOT exported at all: the first-party export service principal received a 401 data-plane Unauthorized reading it (it is not on the vault access policy). No secret material therefore reached the generated configuration, so there is nothing to externalize into secrets.auto.tfvars.example. Non-secret environment identifiers (tenant_id, kv_admin_object_id) were parameterized as ordinary variables with defaults, not treated as secrets.
